oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager - I-2026-1724 - high 5xx rate observed for hosted-inference (eu-west-1). Severity: P2. Alert query: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference",status=~"5.."}[2m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference"}[2m])) > 0.08`. Auto-fallback to model-variant 'redwood-lite' triggered. Incident channel: #incident-i-2026-1724
Maya P: I'm awake, taking primary for the next 2 hours. will start triage now. @Samir K please be ready to take over at 03:00 UTC if I need a break.
Samir K: ack. I'm secondary. in PST, can cover 03:00-07:00 UTC if needed.
Olivia V: I'm technically on vacation but I'm on-call till 01:45 UTC. if you need me to patch things quick til then I can. otherwise I need to hand off before then.
Jordan R: any customer-facing impact so far? any escalations?
Maya P: telemetry shows 502/503 spikes concentrated on model-worker pods serving long-context jobs. ~12 customers saw retries; no SLA page yet but latency/backoff causing user-visible errors on a couple dashboards.
Maya P: quick summary of what I'm doing: 1) checking per-worker OOM logs; 2) disabling long-context batching on eu-west to reduce mem pressure; 3) scaling fallback pool up + verifying routing.
Maya P: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference/worker-oom. key commands:
```
# list pods with OOMKilled
kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide | grep OOMKilled
# tail recent worker logs
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/model-worker --since=10m | grep -i oom
# bump fallback pool
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/redwood-fallback --replicas=6
```
Samir K: if we scale fallback, watch the cost+latency. suggest doing incremental + 1m probe between steps.
Maya P: agreed. scaling to 4 first, probing. doing patch to disable long-context batching now.
oncall-bot: Incident I-2026-1724 created by alertmanager. Severity set to P2. Assigned: Maya P (primary), Samir K (secondary). Bridge: use #incident-i-2026-1724 (Slack).
Kevin L: I can cover overnight from 02:30-06:30 UTC if Samir needs to swap later. last-minute but I can if it matters for customer impact.
Maya P: thanks Kevin. if you can take 02:30-06:30 that covers the window where my team is offline. I'll drop a handoff note before I sign off.
Olivia V: handoff notes (leaving now): 1) fallback scaled to 4. 2) disabled long-context batching in eu-west config (feature flag: `batching.long_context.enabled=false`). 3) if errors climb >10% re-enable canary to redirect 30% to us-east. logs: `kubectl -n inference logs -l app=model-worker --since=5m`.
Jordan R: on customer comms: open a quick status page update if impact persists >30m. add list of affected org IDs from alert: `alert.details.affected_orgs`.
Maya P: confirmed probing: 4 replicas up, error rate dropped to ~4.5% over last 2m. still watching for memory churn.
Samir K: when you hand off, include restart command and safe restart window: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/model-worker --timeout=10m` (do during low traffic only).
Maya P: will do. also adding note: if rollout fails, revert feature-flag and scale down fallback to previous replica count then open bridge with infra.
Kevin L: taking 02:30-06:30 UTC. will be primary then. Samir - can you take secondary 06:30-10:30 UTC?
Samir K: yep, I can.
Maya P: handing off now. Handoff checklist:
- current status: errors down to 3.8% after scaling to 4 and disabling long-context batching
- commands run: `scale fallback -> 4`, `feature flag off`
- monitoring dashboards: tokens -> https://grafana.internal/d/abc/inference; alert rule id: 1423
- next steps if resurfacing: 1) scale fallback to 6, 2) restart small subset of workers, 3) enable canary route to us-east
- customer comms: prepare status page if >30m
Maya P: signing off now, thanks all.
Olivia V: thanks, enjoy the weekend. :tada:
oncall-bot: Incident I-2026-1724 status: monitoring. last update posted by Maya P.
Samir K: I'll synthesize a short summary and post an update at 03:05 UTC when I take over.
Kevin L: noted. I'll ping if I see any regressions.
Jordan R: good coordination. saved runbook snippets to the incident channel for anyone on later shifts. :thumbsup:
